STEP 2 - Ruler: The square plate is about 24 cm across, so its area is roughly 24 x 24 ≈ 550 cm² (corners are rounded, so call it ~500 cm²).

STEP 3 - Items: scrambled egg whites with black pepper, and roasted or fried potato cubes. No visible oil pooling.

STEP 4 - Area: Egg whites cover about 25% of the plate (~125 cm²). Potatoes cover about 15% (~75 cm²). Food covers about 40% in total.

STEP 5 - Volume: Egg whites: 125 cm² x 2.5 cm ≈ 310 ml. Potatoes: 75 cm² x 2.5 cm ≈ 190 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams: Egg whites are fluffy and chunky, so I use a density of about 0.6, giving ~185 g. Potatoes use 0.65, giving ~120 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Egg whites cook to about 52 kcal/100 g, so 185 g gives ~96 kcal. Roasted potatoes are about 150 kcal/100 g (with some oil), so 120 g gives ~180 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: The total is about 305 g and 276 kcal. That is plausible for a moderate breakfast plate.
